frequency_question: How often do executive principals holding direct authority over transboundary river management secure and sign a successor agreement before or near the expiration of a legacy treaty within a comparable short-term window?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral treaties or formal high-level government memorandums of understanding replacing or extending an expiring water-sharing agreement between sovereign states. Excludes multilateral river basins governed by permanent international commissions without direct bilateral treaty renewals.

coverage_note: 6 named cases representing major bilateral water treaty renewals globally since 1970.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller municipal or sub-national river arrangements.
skeleton: Bilateral riparian negotiations leading to formal executive water-sharing renewals within a designated multi-year horizon.
multiplier: 6 identified historical instances of high-stakes transboundary water renewals, yielding 5 hits and 1 miss.
validity_reason: State practice regarding vital transboundary water security changes slowly over decades.
